summary: Veraxa Biotech AG, via Form 6-K, filed a press release announcing in vitro proof-of-concept data for its BiTAC-ADC platform and attendance at the BIO International Convention for partnering discussions. No specific deal terms, stake, or premium were disclosed; the filing is a routine business update on preclinical research. The release highlights platform differentiation but no financial transactions. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are noted. This is a standard operational announcement, not a special situation, so no risk-arb angle applies.
